description: Phantom displayed on Plaj Caddesi at Yalı Mahallesi in Aliağa. Construction number 3307. spottingmode status preserved last updated 28 November 2023. Esri World Imagery examined September 2026 showed groundworks at the recorded point without resolving the airframe, so a site rebuild may have moved it; this is flagged as the least certain of the İzmir monuments.
